text:
ana: Heads-up — I see a cluster of invoice-preview deltas for a handful of tenants after the mergeback job ran at 22:00 UTC. Small residual credits (0.01–0.05 token) showing up as line-item noise. Anyone seen this pattern before?

mike: I saw a spike in 'post-agg remainders' yesterday on the dashboard, thought it was sampling. Can you paste a sample tenant id?

ana: tenant: t-9c3f4a — preview before/after from preview-api: shows total tokens 1023.00 -> 1022.96 and an invoice delta of -0.04.

oliver: that delta smells like rounding/mergeback ordering. Mergeback is the step that coalesces streaming deltas into final tallies right?

jess: Yep — mergeback takes per-shard partial counts and folds them into the canonical ledger. We do a float->int token conversion at the end which can leave tiny residuals if there are racey late-arrivals.

mike: Do we currently keep a "residual" field on events? IIRC we drop sub-token remainders at finalization. If mergeback is running twice for same partition, we might double-subtract.

ana: I dug into the logs. Found this snippet in the finalizer:```
2026-02-18T22:00:12Z INFO finalizer: merging shard s-17 into tally T: delta=1022.96 previous=0.00 applied=1022
2026-02-18T22:00:12Z WARN finalizer: residual=0.96 -> carry=0.96
```
That residual carry looks off — should be <1 but we shouldn't propagate fractional token in the ledger.

oliver: That WARN is from old code path where we kept residual in a transient map and reapply. The new approach should amortize residuals into next-window buckets, not to ledger. Maybe a regression from the canary rollout.

metering-bot: Canary: mergeback-v2 deployed to 10% at 21:45 UTC, processed 120k events, error rate 0.02% :information_source:

jess: If v2 is the one that changed residual handling, can we rollback the canary? Or better: patch to clamp before ledger commit?

mike: Quick mitigation: add a deterministic residual clamp right before commit: compute rounded = floor(tokens); carry = tokens - rounded; if carry > 0.999 then rounded +=1; carry=0.0; commit rounded. Also emit metric metering.mergeback.residual_count.

ana: Sounds reasonable. But two questions: 1) clamp semantics might change customer-facing rounding vs previous behavior, 2) telemetry needs to surface which tenants saw corrections so finance can audit invoice changes.

oliver: For (1) we can gate clamp behind a rollout flag and run for a shadow reconciliation pass for 1h; that will produce invoice-preview diffs but not commit. For (2) add console dashboard panel showing "mergeback-corrections" by tenant + a downloadable CSV.

jess: Agreed. I'll draft a patch: add feature flag `mergeback.clamp_before_commit`, send shadow diffs to `invoices.preview_diff` topic, and emit `mergeback.residual_bytes` metric. Also add a small UI alert in Console under Billing -> Ingest explaining potential minor adjustments and a link to the CSV.

mike: PR ok but keep it small. Also add a unit test that simulates duplicate mergeback invocation for same partition — assert no double-subtract.

ana: Can we also add an internal console alert / rollout note so SRE/oncall don't get paged? Last time this kind of noise triggered non-actionable pages.

jess: I'll set alert severity to info and route to #billing-ops with a 'no-pager' tag. For canary, set flag to shadow mode first. After 1h review, enable clamp and rollback if we see unexplained >$1 deltas.

metering-bot: Task created: MF-4123 "mergeback clamp + shadow preview" assigned to jess, priority P1, eta 2d.

oliver: One more ask: add a telemetry dimension `mergeback_version` to all billing events so we can compare invoice drift before/after rollout.

mike: +1. Also document in the Runbook: how to re-generate preview CSVs and how to do backfill for customers who request explanation.

ana: Thanks all — if someone can post the PR link here when ready I'll kick off the shadow canary.

jess: PR up in a bit, will ping here. :thumbsup:
